name: @dina/adapter-conformance
description: Framework-agnostic behavioral conformance cases run against BOTH the -node and -expo adapter implementations (storage/crypto/keystore). No jest, no native imports, no node:* — loads in a Node jest process AND the React Native bundle, so the SAME assertions run on better-sqlite3/hash-wasm in CI and on op-sqlite/react-native-argon2 on a device.
